summary: Official House transcript in which Eric Schwerin described creating Skaneateles with Hunter Biden, their 75/25 ownership split, their joint 10 percent BHR management-company interest, the September 2017 business unwind completed in March 2019, the no-cash asset swap, and an approximate $450,000 registered-capital valuation for the joint BHR stake.
title: Eric Schwerin transcribed interview — January 30, 2024
